<script>
(function () {
  'use strict';

  var CONSENT_COOKIE = 'zaraz-consent';
  var POLL_MS = 500;
  var POLL_MAX = 240; // ~2 min safety net, then stop

  var banner = document.getElementById('heady-consent-container');
  var acceptBtn = document.getElementById('cookie-accept-btn');
  var settingsBtn = document.getElementById('cookie-settings-btn');
  if (!banner) return;

  function readCookie(name) {
    var parts = (document.cookie || '').split(';');
    for (var i = 0; i < parts.length; i++) {
      var p = parts[i].trim();
      var eq = p.indexOf('=');
      if (eq > -1 && p.slice(0, eq) === name) return decodeURIComponent(p.slice(eq + 1));
    }
    return null;
  }

  // A choice exists once Zaraz has written a non-empty zaraz-consent cookie.
  function hasConsentChoice() {
    var raw = readCookie(CONSENT_COOKIE);
    if (!raw) return false;
    try {
      var parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
      var map = (parsed && (parsed.consent || parsed.purposes)) || parsed;
      if (map && typeof map === 'object') return Object.keys(map).length > 0;
      return !!parsed;
    } catch (e) {
      return raw.length > 0; // non-JSON value still means a stored choice
    }
  }

  var timer = null, polls = 0;
  function stopWatching() { if (timer) { clearInterval(timer); timer = null; } }

  function hide() { banner.hidden = true; stopWatching(); }

  // Catches a choice confirmed inside Zaraz's own settings modal.
  function watchForChoice() {
    if (timer) return;
    timer = setInterval(function () {
      if (hasConsentChoice()) return hide();
      if (++polls >= POLL_MAX) stopWatching();
    }, POLL_MS);
  }

  acceptBtn && acceptBtn.addEventListener('click', function () {
    try {
      if (window.zaraz && zaraz.consent) {
        zaraz.consent.setAll(true);
        zaraz.consent.sendQueuedEvents();
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn('Zaraz consent set failed:', e);
    }
    hide(); // Zaraz writes zaraz-consent; future loads read it
  });

  settingsBtn && settingsBtn.addEventListener('click', function () {
    if (window.zaraz && typeof zaraz.showConsentModal === 'function') {
      zaraz.showConsentModal();
      watchForChoice();
    } else {
      console.warn('Zaraz consent tool not loaded yet.');
    }
  });

  function whenPageLoaded(fn) {
    if (document.readyState === 'complete') return fn();
    window.addEventListener('load', fn, { once: true });
  }

  function whenZarazReady(fn) {
    // The APIReady pre-check matters: on a cached load the event has already fired.
    if (window.zaraz && zaraz.consent && zaraz.consent.APIReady) return fn();
    document.addEventListener('zarazConsentAPIReady', fn, { once: true });
    setTimeout(fn, 4000); // Zaraz blocked or absent — still let people choose
  }

  var booted = false;
  whenPageLoaded(function () {
    whenZarazReady(function () {
      if (booted) return;
      booted = true;
      if (hasConsentChoice()) return; // Req 3: stays hidden until cookies are cleared
      banner.hidden = false;          // Req 2
      watchForChoice();
    });
  });
})();
</script>
